title: 第十五章 赠丹闭关第十六章 地仙成地仙之祖的格局
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
丹成之后，凌虚洞外的平地上仍旧弥漫着淡淡的药香。
丹炉的余温尚未散尽，炉壁上那层暗红色的火光渐渐褪去，恢复青铜原本的古朴色泽。
凌虚子站在丹炉旁，伸手抚过炉身，指尖感受到的温热像是最后的一点余韵。
吴耀将盛放归元丹的玉瓶封好，又走到那座陪伴了他大半年的小号青铜丹炉前。
这座丹炉是凌虚子当初执意相赠的，虽说只是凡俗之物，但炉壁厚实、火道通畅，在凡俗丹炉中已算顶尖。
他拍了拍炉身，将丹炉收入储物袋中，转身对凌虚子郑重行了一礼。
“此番炼丹，全仗道友鼎力相助。这份情谊，我记下了。”
凌虚子连忙扶住他的手臂，瘦削的脸上露出几分不自在的神色，嘴里嘟囔道：
“道友说哪里话。
若非你以诚相待，将五毒丹经毫无保留地给贫道看，贫道这大半年的丹道造诣也不会精进至此。你我之间，不必说这些。”
“今日暂且别过。”
吴耀道，“待我突破之后，再来与道友叙旧。”
凌虚子点了点头，将吴耀送到洞外，站在那两盆灵草旁边目送他驾起遁光。
清风托着那道金色的身影扶摇直上，转瞬便消失在天际。
凌虚子负手站了片刻，忽然转身快步走回洞中。
嘴里念叨着“方才收丹的手法好像还有改进的余地”，一头扎进了满桌的丹经之中。
吴耀离开凌虚洞后，没有直接回黄花山，而是先绕道去了黑风山。
他与熊罴相交多年，此番突破地仙事关重大，于情于理都该知会一声。
况且五毒归元丹已成，他就打算分给熊罴两颗。
这黑熊精根基扎实，修炼也勤勉，只是缺了些外力辅助，有了归元丹相助，说不定也能百尺竿头更进一步。

遁光尚未落稳，黑风洞中便涌出一团黑风。
熊罴那丈余高的身影从黑风中踏出，声如洪钟：“吴道友！你可算来了！”
他几步跨到吴耀面前，蒲扇大的巴掌在吴耀肩上连拍了两下，震得旁边的树叶簌簌往下掉。
“俺隔着几十里就闻到你身上那股药香了。”
熊罴咧着大嘴笑道，“前几日又见凌虚洞方向金光冲天、云层聚散，俺就知道那五毒归元丹成了。
今日你来找俺，可是准备回山突破？”
吴耀点了点头：“正是。”
他从怀中取出玉瓶，倒出两颗暗金色的归元丹。
丹药在掌心中滴溜溜转了两圈，丹纹在日光下泛起层层内敛的莹光。
他将两颗丹药递到熊罴面前。
“这两颗归元丹，你收好。
你的修为也到了炼虚合道的瓶颈，若遇契机，或许能借此突破。”
熊罴低头看着那两颗丹药，喉结动了动，没有立刻伸手去接。
他修炼了数百年，从一头浑浑噩噩的黑熊修到如今的地步，靠的是日复一日扛石头跑山的笨功夫。
其间也不是没想过借助丹药之力，但一来没有门路，二来也不屑与那些吃人喝血的妖怪为伍。
眼前这两颗归元丹，是他这辈子收到的最贵重的东西。
“道友，”熊罴的声音少见地低了几分，“你这人情，俺熊罴这辈子怕是还不完了。”
“不用还。”吴耀将丹药塞进他手里，语气平淡却认真。
“当年在黄花山上我跟你说过，你我虽出身妖类，但都有向道之心，这条路本就孤独，理当互相扶持。”
content_en:
After the elixir was completed, the flat ground outside Lingxu Cave was still filled with a faint medicinal fragrance.
The residual warmth of the alchemy furnace has not yet dissipated, and the dark red firelight on the furnace wall gradually faded away, restoring the original simple color of the bronze.
Ling Xuzi stood next to the alchemy furnace and stretched out his hand to touch the body of the furnace. The warmth he felt on his fingertips was like the last lingering aftertaste.
Wu Yao sealed the jade bottle containing the Guiyuan Pill and walked to the small bronze pill furnace that had been with him for more than half a year.
This alchemy furnace was originally gifted by Ling Xuzi. Although it was only an ordinary thing, the furnace wall was thick and the fire channel was smooth. It was considered top-notch among ordinary alchemy furnaces.
He patted the furnace body, put the alchemy furnace into his storage bag, turned around and saluted Ling Xuzi solemnly.
"This alchemy is all thanks to the help of fellow Taoists. I will remember this friendship."
Ling Xuzi quickly held his arm, with a somewhat uncomfortable look on his thin face, and muttered:
"What did fellow Taoist say?
If you hadn't been sincere and shown the Five Poisons Alchemy Sutra to Pindao without any reservation, Pindao wouldn't have improved to this point in his alchemy attainments over the past six months. Between you and me, there is no need to say this. "
"Let's say goodbye today."
Wu Yaodao said, "After I make a breakthrough, I will come back to reminisce with my fellow Taoists."
Ling Xuzi nodded and sent Wu Yao outside the cave, standing next to the two pots of spiritual grass and watching him take off to escape the light.
The breeze carried the golden figure soaring upwards, and disappeared into the sky in an instant.
Ling Xuzi stood with his hands behind his hands for a moment, then suddenly turned around and walked quickly back to the cave.
He muttered, "The method of collecting pills just now seems to have room for improvement," and dove into the table full of pill scriptures.
After Wu Yao left Lingxu Cave, he did not go back to Huanghua Mountain directly, but took a detour to Black Wind Mountain.
He has known Xiong Zan for many years. This breakthrough to the Earth Immortal is of great importance, and he should be informed both emotionally and rationally.
Besides, the Five Poisons Guiyuan Pill has been completed, so he plans to give two pills to Xiong Zhen.
This black bear spirit has a solid foundation and practices diligently, but it lacks some external support. With the help of the Guiyuan Pill, he might be able to make further progress.
Before the escape light could stabilize, a black wind surged out of the Batu Cave.
Xiong Zhen's figure that was more than ten feet tall stepped out of the black wind, and his voice was like a bell: "Fellow Daoist Wu! You are finally here!"
He stepped in front of Wu Yao in a few steps, and slapped Wu Yao twice on the shoulder with a palm as big as a cattail leaf fan, causing the leaves next to him to fall rustlingly.
"I can smell the medicinal fragrance on your body from dozens of miles away."
Xiong Yan grinned widely and said, "A few days ago, I saw the golden light rising into the sky and the clouds gathering and dispersing in the direction of Lingxu Cave. I knew that the Five Poison Guiyuan Pill was ready.
You came to see me today, but are you ready to go back to the mountain to break through? "
Wu Yao nodded: "Exactly."
He took out the jade bottle from his arms and poured out two dark golden Guiyuan Pills.
The elixir rolled around twice in the palm of my hand, and the elixir pattern glowed with a restrained gleam under the sunlight.
He handed the two pills to Xiong Yan.
"Put these two Guiyuan Pills away.
Your cultivation has also reached the bottleneck of refining the virtual world and combining it with the Tao. If you encounter an opportunity, you may be able to break through. "
Xiong Yan looked down at the two pills, his Adam's apple moved, but he did not immediately reach out to take them.
He has been practicing for hundreds of years, and he has cultivated from a confused black bear to where he is now, relying on his stupid skills of carrying rocks and running mountains day after day.
It's not like I didn't think about using the power of elixirs, but firstly I had no way, and secondly I didn't bother to associate with those monsters that eat people and drink blood.
The two Guiyuan Pills in front of him were the most precious things he had ever received in his life.
"Fellow Taoist," Xiong Zhen's voice was a little lower than usual, "I'm afraid Xiong Zhen may not be able to use up your favor in this lifetime."
"No need to pay it back." Wu Yao put the elixir into his hand with a calm but serious tone.
"I told you back then on Huanghua Mountain that although you and I were born as monsters, we both have a heart for the Tao. This road is inherently lonely, and we should support each other."
